date-range-picker.$description: DateRangePicker's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--date-range-picker-<name>) on the page, a container or one picker. Its calendar button and popup use the --date-picker-* tokens and its days the --calendar-* tokens. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

dash.$description: The dash between the two fields.

status-color.$description: "Choose the start date" under the months (4.5:1 on surface).

field-width.$description: Each field's width (96px), enough for a full date.
